whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Jungle Safari,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.4★ reviews from over 2,500 happy diners in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special dining menu, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://arclane-studios.github.io/jungle-safari-patna/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Jungle Safari Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Jungle Safari on Ashiana-Digha Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu, and your 2,500+ Google reviews showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
